typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		LchMatchedTradeRef as string,
		Party_A_LegType as string,
		NotionalAmount as string,
		Party_A_Rate as string,
		Currency as string,
		Party_A_EffectiveDate as string,
		MaturityDate as string,
		Party_A_Spread as string,
		Party_B_Rate as string,
		Party_B_Spread as string,
		Party_B_EffectiveDate as string,
		Party_B_LegType as string,
		ActualNPV as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		Party_A_DayCountFraction as string,
		Party_A_PmtFrequency as string,
		ProductType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> IRSSource	source(output(
		CobDate as string,
		Party_A_MbrMnemonic as string,
		Party_A_SdMnemonic as string,
		Party_A_Account as string,
		LchMatchedTradeRef as string,
		ExternalSourceRef as string,
		Party_A_SdTradeId as string,
		Currency as string,
		NotionalAmount as string,
		Party_A_LegDescription as string,
		Party_A_LegType as string,
		CashFlowType as string,
		PeriodStartDate as date,
		Party_A_Rate as string,
		Spread as string,
		Party_A_IndexName as string,
		Party_A_FirstTenor as string,
		Party_A_SecondTenor as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> lch106	source(output(
		LchMatchedTradeRef as string,
		NotionalAmount as string,
		PeriodStartDate as date,
		Party_A_LegDescription as string,
		Party_A_LegType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> lch1061
IRSSource split(isNull(LchMatchedTradeRef) == 0, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
lch106 split((greaterOrEqual(toDate(PeriodStartDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),currentDate())), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
lch1061 sort(asc(LchMatchedTradeRef, false),asc(PeriodStartDate, false),asc(Party_A_LegDescription, false),asc(Party_A_LegType, false)) ~> Sort31
ConditionalSplit@Case1 sort(asc(LchMatchedTradeRef, false)) ~> Sort1
ConditionalSplit1@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput aggregate(groupBy(LchMatchedTradeRef,Party_A_LegDescription,Party_A_LegType),
	PeriodStartDate = min(PeriodStartDate)) ~> Aggregate
Sort1 derive(DIRECTION = 'Pay',
		Party_B_Rate = iifNull(Party_B_Rate,'0'),
		Party_A_Rate = iifNull(Party_A_Rate,'0')) ~> DerivedColumn13
Aggregate sort(asc(LchMatchedTradeRef, false),asc(PeriodStartDate, false),asc(Party_A_LegDescription, false),asc(Party_A_LegType, false)) ~> Sort3
DerivedColumn13 derive(Party_A_LegType = iif(Party_A_LegType == 'FIX', 'Fixed', 'Float')) ~> DerivedColumn122
Sort3,Sort31 join(Aggregate@LchMatchedTradeRef == lch1061@LchMatchedTradeRef && Aggregate@PeriodStartDate == lch1061@PeriodStartDate && Aggregate@Party_A_LegDescription == lch1061@Party_A_LegDescription && Aggregate@Party_A_LegType == lch1061@Party_A_LegType,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
DerivedColumn122 sort(asc(LchMatchedTradeRef, false)) ~> Sort22
MergeJoin select(mapColumn(
		LchMatchedTradeRef = lch1061@LchMatchedTradeRef,
		PeriodStartDate = lch1061@PeriodStartDate,
		NotionalAmount = NotionalAmount,
		Party_A_LegDescription = lch1061@Party_A_LegDescription,
		{Party_A_LegDescription (1)} = {Party_A_LegDescription (1)},
		Party_A_LegType = lch1061@Party_A_LegType
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoin01
Sort22 derive(DIRECTION = 'Receive',
		Party_B_Rate = iifNull(Party_B_Rate,'0'),
		Party_A_Rate = iifNull(Party_A_Rate,'0')) ~> DerivedColumn111
MergeJoin01 derive(LchMatchedTradeRef = LchMatchedTradeRef,
		PeriodStartDate = PeriodStartDate,
		NotionalAmount = NotionalAmount,
		Party_A_LegDescription = Party_A_LegDescription,
		{Party_A_LegDescription 1} = {Party_A_LegDescription 1},
		Party_A_LegType = Party_A_LegType) ~> MergeJoin0
DerivedColumn111 derive(Party_B_LegType = iif(Party_B_LegType == 'FIX', 'Fixed', 'Float')) ~> DerivedColumn1211
MergeJoin0 derive({Derived Column 1} = iif(Party_A_LegDescription == 'P', 'Pay', 'Receive'),
		{Derived Column 2} = iif(Party_A_LegType == 'FIX', 'Fixed', 'Float')) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn1211 sort(asc(LchMatchedTradeRef, false)) ~> Sort211
DerivedColumn sort(asc(LchMatchedTradeRef, false),asc({Derived Column 1}, false),asc({Derived Column 2}, false)) ~> Sort4
Merge sort(asc(LchMatchedTradeRef, false),asc(DIRECTION, false),asc(Party_A_LegType, false)) ~> Sort5
Sort5,Sort4 join(Merge@LchMatchedTradeRef == MergeJoin0@LchMatchedTradeRef && DIRECTION == {Derived Column 1} && LegType == {Derived Column 2},
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin1
MergeJoin1 select(mapColumn(
		LchMatchedTradeRef = Merge@LchMatchedTradeRef,
		NotionalAmount = Merge@NotionalAmount,
		MaturityDate = MaturityDate,
		Currency = Currency,
		DIRECTION = DIRECTION,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		LegType = LegType,
		Party_A_Rate = Party_A_Rate,
		Party_A_Spread = Party_A_Spread,
		Party_A_PmtFrequency = Party_A_PmtFrequency,
		Party_A_DayCountFraction = Party_A_DayCountFraction,
		PeriodStartDate = PeriodStartDate,
		{NotionalAmount (1)} = {NotionalAmount (1)},
		Party_A_LegDescription = Party_A_LegDescription,
		ProductType = ProductType
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoin101
MergeJoin101 derive(LchMatchedTradeRef = LchMatchedTradeRef,
		NotionalAmount = NotionalAmount,
		MaturityDate = MaturityDate,
		Currency = Currency,
		DIRECTION = DIRECTION,
		TradeDate = TradeDate,
		LegType = LegType,
		Party_A_Rate = Party_A_Rate,
		Party_A_Spread = Party_A_Spread,
		Party_A_PmtFrequency = Party_A_PmtFrequency,
		Party_A_DayCountFraction = Party_A_DayCountFraction,
		PeriodStartDate = PeriodStartDate,
		{NotionalAmount 1} = {NotionalAmount 1},
		Party_A_LegDescription = Party_A_LegDescription,
		ProductType = ProductType) ~> MergeJoin10
MergeJoin10 derive(FWDRate = '0',
		Party_A_PmtFrequency = iif(ProductType == 'Inflation ZC', 'ZC', Party_A_PmtFrequency),
		NotionalAmount = iif(isNull({NotionalAmount (1)}) == 1, NotionalAmount, {NotionalAmount (1)})) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 derive(Party_A_Spread = iif(iif(isNull(Spread) == 1, '0.0', substring(toString(Spread), toInteger(1), toInteger(1)) == '.'), '0' + Spread, Spread),
		TradeDate = replace(EffectiveDate, toString('/'), toString('-')),
		MaturityDate = replace(MaturityDate, toString('/'), toString('-')),
		Party_A_Rate = iif(iif(substring(toString(Rate), toInteger(1), toInteger(1)) == '0', '0.0', substring(toString(Rate), toInteger(1), toInteger(1)) == '.'), '0' + Rate, iifNull(Rate,'0')),
		LegType = replace(replace(LegType, toString('FIX'), toString('Fixed')), toString('FLT'), toString('Float'))) ~> CleanUpRubble
CleanUpRubble derive(Party_A_Spread = replace(Spread, toString('-.'), toString('-0.')),
		Party_A_Rate = replace(Rate, toString('-.'), toString('-0.'))) ~> FixSpreadetc
FixSpreadetc derive(Party_A_Spread = iif(Spread == '0', '0.0', Spread),
		Party_A_PmtFrequency = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(PaymentFreq, toString('6M'), toString('SA')), toString('3M'), toString('QTR')), toString('1M'), toString('MTH')), toString('1Y'), toString('PA')), toString('1T'), toString('ZC')),
		MaturityDate = toDate(MaturityDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		Party_A_Rate = iif(isNull(Rate) == 1, replace(ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(Rate),' ')),' '), toString(''), toString('0')), replace(ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(Rate),' ')),' '), toString(''), toString('0'))),
		Party_A_DayCountFraction = replace(replace(replace(DayCount, toString('ACT/365.FIXED'), toString('ACT/365')), toString('ACT/ACT.ICMA'), toString('ACTB/ACTB')), toString('ACT/ACT.ISDA'), toString('ACT/ACT'))) ~> FixRate
FixRate split(toDate(MaturityDate, "MM/dd/yyyy") > toDate(FileDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"), disjoint: true) ~> MaturityDateBeforeoronToday@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
MaturityDateBeforeoronToday@Case1 derive({Copy of PeriodStartDate} = PeriodStartDate,
		{Copy of EffectiveDate} = toDate(TradeDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of PaymentFreq} = Party_A_PmtFrequency,
		{Copy of MaturityDate} = toDate(MaturityDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of Spread} = Party_A_Spread,
		{Copy of FWDRate} = toInteger(FWDRate),
		{Copy of NotionalAmount} = toInteger(NotionalAmount),
		{Copy of Direction} = DIRECTION,
		{Copy of LegType} = LegType,
		{Copy of Rate} = toInteger(Party_A_Rate),
		{Copy of Currency} = Currency,
		{Copy of LchMatchedTradeRef} = LchMatchedTradeRef,
		{Copy of DayCount} = Party_A_DayCountFraction) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Spread as string,
		Party_A_LegType as string,
		Rate as string,
		Currency as string,
		DayCount as string,
		NotionalAmount as string,
		LchMatchedTradeRef as string,
		MaturityDate as string,
		EffectiveDt as string,
		PaymentFreq as string,
		Direction as string,
		FWDRate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Spread = {Copy of Spread},
		Party_A_LegType = {Copy of LegType},
		Rate = {Copy of Rate},
		Currency = {Copy of Currency},
		DayCount = {Copy of DayCount},
		NotionalAmount = {Copy of NotionalAmount},
		LchMatchedTradeRef = {Copy of LchMatchedTradeRef},
		MaturityDate = {Copy of MaturityDate},
		EffectiveDt = {Copy of EffectiveDate},
		PaymentFreq = {Copy of PaymentFreq},
		Direction = {Copy of Direction},
		FWDRate = {Copy of FWDRate})) ~> LCHCompare
